scenario_notes: Well-rounded Cavalry formation and expert counter to Velar/Vhagar/Moondancer with Shieldbearers. The listed order is user-confirmed as Left Flank, Vanguard, Right Flank. All dragons on both sides are Level 50 and 6 Stars; each unlocked Habit is Level 5. Power is unknown.
known_candidate_roster: All screenshot-audited, campaign-observed, and user-confirmed available dragons
why_experts_use_it: Perfect Cavalry affinity and troop advantage into Shieldbearers, Malachite Recovery and support, Seasmoke removal of enemy positive effects, and Kalspire's broad stat pressure and damage-over-time package.
source_or_observation: Current expert benchmark supplied by the user on 2026-10-01. The user's phrase 'Seasmoke cleanse habit' is normalized to the canonical source: enemy-positive-effect Cleanse is in Cleansing Wrath; the 6-Star Infectious Wrath Habit adds Recovery suppression and Panic-reactive Physical damage.

baseline.input: Counter a Level 50, 6-Star Velar Left/Vhagar Vanguard/Moondancer Right Shieldbearer formation using the full known roster. All unlocked Habits are Level 5; Power is unknown.
baseline.recommendation: Malachite Left Flank, Seasmoke Vanguard, Kalspire Right Flank with Cavalry. The baseline identifies perfect affinity, Cavalry's troop advantage over Shieldbearers, Seasmoke's enemy-positive-effect Cleanse, Malachite's sustain, and Kalspire's pressure.
baseline.disagreement: None on formation. The expert shorthand attributes Cleanse to a Habit, while canonical evidence places it in Seasmoke's Command. The baseline does not fully inventory which Velar/Vhagar/Moondancer buffs are probabilistically removable versus effects that are not covered.

revised.input: Same benchmark input and assumptions as baseline.
revised.recommendation: Malachite Left Flank, Seasmoke Vanguard, Kalspire Right Flank with Cavalry remains the best-supported counter. Cavalry directly counters the enemy Shieldbearers; Seasmoke attempts up to three separate 20% enemy-buff Cleanses each round; Malachite supplies Recovery and, at Habit Level 5, a 20% Advantage chance for both allies; Kalspire's Level 5 six-Star track reaches a 30% Panic chance and 50% Physical damage-rate track. Seasmoke's Vanguard protects Kalspire on the Right Flank.
revised.disagreement: None on formation. Revised reasoning corrects the Command/Habit attribution and labels Seasmoke's removal as probabilistic rather than a blanket hard counter to every buff instance.

variations.change: Replace the Shieldbearer buff-heavy opponent with a low-buff Spearmen formation.
variations.expected_general_rule: Cavalry loses its troop advantage and Seasmoke loses much of its counter-specific value. Do not preserve this trio as a universal answer solely because it is a benchmark meta composition.
variations.result: Passed: Spearmen directly counter Cavalry and the low-buff enemy reduces Seasmoke's removal value, so the revised method requires a new counter search instead of reusing the benchmark trio.
